_notes: connectorAttributes set per profile by `isc-source.sh configure --profiles`, merged in this order: readonly first (base settings), then the selected profiles (later ones win). machine-identity turns the user- and system-assigned managed identities on as accounts (off in readonly) so machine account classification's managed-identity criteria have accounts to match. Values mirror a working UI-configured Microsoft Entra source (2026-10-08); field names come from the live source-config form (UI label -> field in references/isc-api.md). configure only sends fields present on your tenant's form and reports the rest. Note the label swap: 'Manage Role Memberships' = spnManageDirectoryRole, 'Manage Microsoft Entra Role Assignment Memberships' = spnManageRBACRoles.
